meta.title: Auto-Assign Signal
meta.description: Fires for EVERY captured signal, with no exceptions — a signal is never left unassigned. Evaluates Sender Rules View using the contact+group > contact > group specificity order; if a rule matches, assigns to that rule's project (which may itself be the 'unassigned' pseudo-project, e.g. an explicit exception rule). If no rule matches at all, defaults to 'unassigned'. Either way, exactly one AssignSignalToProject command always fires.
